post_details: Hi, tell me, is it possible to run the program on a new chip from an apple M1? I saw a message that development is planned and that CLO program is already working on new PCs, but I do not see a new chip in the system requirements. Thanks!
post_description: This web page aims to provide clarity on the compatibility of Marvelous Designer with Apple M1 chips and updates on its development for new hardware.

comments.comment_body: Hello 903191109283, Thank you for contacting us. In response to your question, apple M1 is not officially supported by Marvelous Designer at this moment, but you would be able to use with Apple M1 device for Marvelous Designer. However, since this system is not officially supported, there would be minor issue appearing on your use. Our development team is underway to test it. We will announce it once we officially support the Apple M1 for Marvelous Designer. I'd like to recommend you to test our trial license first to see it works with your PC before you purchase the license. If you need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us! Thank you.

post_title: Error - 'Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time.'
